data.name: kpti_0001_title
data.value: cutLength parameter may be too large

data.name: kpti_0001_message_format
data.value: This value is usually no greater than 1. Did you mean 1 / {0}?

data.name: kpti_0001_description
data.value: The cutLength parameter passed to CutEventToLinear/CutEventsInRange is greater than 1 and may be missing a reciprocal operation.

data.name: kpti_0002_title
data.value: cutLength parameter may be incorrect

data.name: kpti_0002_message_format
data.value: This value is usually not equal to 1. Did you mean a fraction or the reciprocal of a value?

data.name: kpti_0002_description
data.value: The cutLength parameter passed to CutEventToLinear/CutEventsInRange equals 1 and may not be the intended cut length.

data.name: kpti_0001_code_fix_title
data.value: Change cutLength to its reciprocal

data.name: kpte_0001_title
data.value: Tolerance parameter may be too large

data.name: kpte_0001_message_format
data.value: Tolerance parameters are percentages. The value {0} is too large; did you mean {0} / 100?

data.name: kpte_0001_description
data.value: Tolerance parameters are percentages. Values greater than or equal to 100 can make parent-line unbinding results unpredictable.

data.name: kpte_0001_code_fix_title
data.value: Divide the tolerance parameter by 100

data.name: kpti_0003_title
data.value: Tolerance parameter may be too small

data.name: kpti_0003_message_format
data.value: Tolerance parameters are percentages. The value {0} is too small and may cause the final result to consume a large amount of memory; did you mean {0} * 100?

data.name: kpti_0003_description
data.value: Tolerance parameters are percentages. Values smaller than 0.01 may generate many events and consume excessive memory.

data.name: kpti_0003_code_fix_title
data.value: Multiply the tolerance parameter by 100

data.name: kptr_0001_title
data.value: Dynamic unbinding may waste performance

data.name: kptr_0001_message_format
data.value: Adaptive sampling uses a tolerance of 0, which may incur extra performance cost. If you intend to disable tolerance behavior, use the regular unbinder instead.

data.name: kptr_0001_description
data.value: An adaptive sampling tolerance of 0 may incur extra performance cost. Use the regular unbinder without tolerance parameters to disable tolerance behavior.

data.name: kptr_0001_code_fix_title
data.value: Use the regular FatherUnbind unbinder

data.name: kpte_0002_title
data.value: Sampling precision must be greater than 0

data.name: kpte_0002_message_format
data.value: The precision parameter must be greater than 0, but the current value is {0}.

data.name: kpte_0002_description
data.value: A precision of 0 or less passed to sampling methods always throws at runtime.

data.name: kpte_0003_title
data.value: Sampling precision exceeds the maximum

data.name: kpte_0003_message_format
data.value: The precision parameter exceeds the maximum allowed value of 1024, but the current value is {0}.

data.name: kpte_0003_description
data.value: A precision exceeding the runtime limit always throws at runtime.

data.name: kptr_0002_title
data.value: Sampling precision may be too high

data.name: kptr_0002_message_format
data.value: The precision {0} is high and may generate many events and consume excessive memory; please confirm this is intentional.

data.name: kptr_0002_description
data.value: A precision above 256 generates a large number of sampling segments, which may significantly increase memory and time usage.

data.name: kpte_0004_title
data.value: Tolerance parameter may be too large

data.name: kpte_0004_message_format
data.value: Tolerance parameters are percentages. The value {0} is too large and may make fitting or compression results unreliable.

data.name: kpte_0004_description
data.value: A tolerance of 100 or more makes fitting or compression results meaningless and hard to predict.

data.name: kpte_0005_title
data.value: Tolerance parameter must not be negative

data.name: kpte_0005_message_format
data.value: The tolerance parameter cannot be negative; the current value is {0}.

data.name: kpte_0005_description
data.value: A negative tolerance is rejected at runtime and has no meaning as a percentage.

data.name: kpti_0004_title
data.value: Zero tolerance may disable fitting or compression

data.name: kpti_0004_message_format
data.value: A tolerance of 0 degrades fitting or compression to keeping the original events; is this intentional?

data.name: kpti_0004_description
data.value: A tolerance of 0 requires every sample point to match exactly, so fitting or compression typically merges nothing.

data.name: kpte_0010_title
data.value: Convert option value must be positive

data.name: kpte_0010_message_format
data.value: The convert option property {0} must be positive, but the current value is {1}.

data.name: kpte_0010_description
data.value: Precision, ratio and other convert options must be positive; otherwise runtime validation throws.

data.name: kpte_0011_title
data.value: Convert option tolerance is out of range

data.name: kpte_0011_message_format
data.value: The convert option tolerance property {0} must be between 0 and 100, but the current value is {1}.

data.name: kpte_0011_description
data.value: Tolerance properties in convert options use percentages; values outside 0 to 100 are rejected at runtime.

data.name: kpte_0012_title
data.value: Trailing beat padding must not be negative

data.name: kpte_0012_message_format
data.value: The convert option property {0} cannot be negative, but the current value is {1}.

data.name: kpte_0012_description
data.value: Negative values for non-negative properties such as trailing beat padding throw at runtime validation.

data.name: kpte_0013_title
data.value: Render option value is out of range

data.name: kpte_0013_message_format
data.value: The render option property {0} has the invalid value {1}; allowed range: {2}.

data.name: kpte_0013_description
data.value: KpcRenderOptions numeric properties outside the allowed range throw before rendering.
